auto1_bullet_pool.html: Managed the end-to-end rollout, stakeholder alignment, and continuous optimization of an AI voice bot across 9 international markets within a cross-functional product team, routing millions of calls, increasing inbound answer rates by over 80%, and lifting call-to-booking conversion by over 50%.

Implemented, structured, and maintained an AI chatbot, voicebot prompting & FAQs (Parloa & ElevenLabs), and AI knowledge bases, coordinating multi-market releases and answer-accuracy improvements across 760,000+ customer conversations.

Partnered with 3 project managers to track project milestones and multi-market KPIs, performing quantitative analysis on complex datasets using SQL (Redash) and Advanced Excel to build automated company-wide dashboards.

Scoped operational bottlenecks and built an internal AI Conversation QA & Evaluation web platform with n8n workflow logic and bulk-review evaluation pipelines, standardizing how cross-market teams audit and benchmark AI quality across 9 European markets.

Built and rolled out a centralized Google Reviews & Trustpilot AI management web portal across 9 markets, streamlining customer sentiment analysis and smart response generation with a one-click approval workflow.

Developed an automated Price-Lead Offer Email engine in n8n integrating internal admin systems, Freshdesk REST APIs, and low-code workflows to extract customer data and auto-generate personalized offer emails.
Designed and launched 'Compass', a centralized multi-country knowledge base with an AI Assistant and smart search across 9 European markets, eliminating redundant documentation friction.

Engineered an automated Contract Amendment (Änderungsvertrag) Tool combining digital forms and dynamic PDF generation scripts for DE & AT, end-to-end automating contract generation and status tracking across thousands of amendments.

Automated customer feedback classification and executive reporting across ~260 branch locations using custom data pipelines, delivering actionable NPS intelligence to leadership across European branches.

Maintained high-velocity tooling delivery across 9 European markets, shipping 10 production automation initiatives in 2026 alone (~1,070+ hours saved, 5+ FTE estimated impact) alongside ongoing voicebot and data governance.
